page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.large is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This hardware profile contains no local storage and does not include any integrated GPUs.

For connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants. Given the high memory density relative to the processing cores, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints without demanding massive parallel CPU power.

This instance is suited for memory-intensive applications, small-scale databases, caching layers, and lightweight enterprise applications that benefit from dedicated Intel Xeon processing and a high RAM-to-vCPU ratio.
